name: How long does a foreclosed property rehab usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a foreclosed property rehab usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The renovation timeline typically ranges from several weeks for minor cosmetic repairs to four to six months for complete interior overhauls. Project duration depends directly on the level of neglect, property size, and whether essential services like power and water are already operational. Delays often stem from discovering concealed issues, such as rotted framing behind shower walls or cut wiring within drywall. Setting realistic schedules involves ordering long-lead materials early, scheduling trade work logically, and prioritizing infrastructure repairs before installing cabinets, moldings, and flooring.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foreclosure remodels usually take between several weeks for cosmetic touch-ups and four to six months for extensive gut renovations and infrastructure updates.
